title: Automated Benchmark Generation for Repository-Level Coding Tasks
authors_zh: Konstantinos Vergopoulos, Mark Niklas Müller, Martin Vechev
paper_type_zh: 仓库级代码智能体基准与自动构造配方
best_for_zh: 研究仓库级代码智能体评测、历史环境重建、测试终态判定和基准发布审计的读者
one_line: SetUpAgent turns issue-resolving GitHub pull requests into executable repository tasks by reconstructing historical dependencies and parsing tests; paper-time SWA/SWEE scales are 535/885 tasks, while current Hub releases expose 450/798.
SetUpAgent 通过历史依赖重建、测试解析与 F2P/P2P 终态契约构造 SWA-Bench 和 SWEE-Bench，但公开行数漂移、数据集许可和生成源码仍阻碍可复现实验。
why: It shows how an agent benchmark's real data object includes pinned repository state, setup commands, tests, parsers, containers, and a terminal predicate, and why release drift can undermine otherwise programmatic evaluation.
inclusion_reason: This paper makes repository-level agent evaluation data concrete as issue-plus-repository tasks coupled to historically constrained executable environments, test-behavior partitions, and a terminal resolution predicate, while its current releases expose consequential version, license, and replay gaps.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The authoritative source is the ICML 2025 paper in PMLR volume 267, pages 61240–61265; the arXiv v1 record is used only where version differences are stated. The paper asks how to construct repository-level coding benchmarks beyond a small manually configured repository set when each issue must be replayed in a historically accurate dependency and test environment. SWE-bench's manual setup burden and concentration on 12 popular repositories motivate the problem (Paper §1, pp. 1–2; PMLR record).

The engineering gap is not task generation alone. A usable instance needs an executable pre-fix checkout, the correct historical dependencies, commands that run the intended tests, a reference code patch and test patch, and a parser that converts heterogeneous logs into test outcomes. SetUpAgent automates this environment layer, after which the authors construct SWA-Bench for Python applications and SWEE-Bench for a broader PyPI-oriented repository pool (Paper §§3–4, pp. 3–6).

This Card belongs to environment_agent_trajectory_data because the evaluation object couples a repository state to an executable Docker environment and a terminal success predicate. It does not document a released agent trajectory corpus: public rows contain tasks, patches, setup commands, test partitions, and environment references, but no action/observation stream, tool-call history, reasoning trace, or per-step reward.

One benchmark instance includes repo, base_commit, issue text and hints, human reference patch and test_patch, timestamps, PASS_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_FAIL/FAIL_TO_PASS/FAIL_TO_FAIL lists, install and test commands, parser/framework metadata, and a Docker image root. The Atlas value is therefore the explicit connection between task provenance, environment reconstruction, executable feedback, and release audit. The evidence is sufficient for a bilingual Card, while SetUpAgent source, immutable environment manifests, dataset license, and release-count reconciliation remain unknown.

本卡以 ICML 2025 正式论文为权威来源；该文收录于 PMLR 第 267 卷，页码 61240–61265，只有在说明版本差异时才使用 arXiv v1。论文要回答的问题是：当每个 GitHub issue 都必须在历史依赖与测试环境中重放时，如何突破少量人工配置仓库的限制，自动构造仓库级代码基准。SWE-bench 的手工环境配置成本以及仅集中于 12 个热门仓库的范围构成直接动机（论文 §1，pp. 1–2；PMLR 条目）。

这里的工程缺口不只是生成任务。一个可用实例还需要可执行的修复前代码版本、正确的历史依赖、能运行目标测试的命令、人工参考代码补丁和测试补丁，以及把异构日志转换为测试结果的 parser。SetUpAgent 自动化了这一环境层，作者随后构造了面向 Python 应用的 SWA-Bench，以及覆盖更广 PyPI 仓库池的 SWEE-Bench（论文 §§3–4，pp. 3–6）。

本卡归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为评测对象把仓库状态、可执行 Docker 环境和终态成功谓词绑定在一起。它不是 agent trajectory 语料发布：公开记录包含任务、补丁、环境命令、测试分区和环境引用，但不包含 action/observation 流、工具调用历史、推理轨迹或逐步 reward。

一个基准实例包含 repo、base_commit、issue 文本与 hints、人工参考 patch 与 test_patch、时间戳、PASS_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_FAIL/FAIL_TO_PASS/FAIL_TO_FAIL 列表、安装与测试命令、parser/framework 元数据和 Docker image root。其 Atlas 价值是把任务 provenance、环境重建、可执行反馈和发布审计明确连接起来。现有证据足以形成双语 Card，但 SetUpAgent 源码、不可变环境 manifest、数据集 license 和发布行数对账仍为 unknown。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SetUpAgent turns repository documentation and execution feedback into historically constrained install/test commands, allowing issue-resolving pull requests to become executable SWA-Bench and SWEE-Bench instances without per-repository manual setup.

Its mechanism has three author-defined phases. Command extraction reads repository text, CI/CD files, and referenced web pages; dependency resolution uses uv and excludes versions released after the issue date. Iterative testing runs the proposed commands in a clean Docker container, classifies installation, testing, or Python failures with an LLM, and revises commands for at most four iterations. Validation first uses an LLM success judgment, then requests per-test output, selects a parser, and accepts the setup when at least 95% of parsed tests pass (Paper §3.3 and Figures 1–4, pp. 2–4; Appendix B, pp. 13–20).

The feedback contract has two distinct layers. During construction, LLM judgments, process exit behavior, test parsing, and the 95% threshold decide whether an environment is usable; an instance is retained only when reference executions before and after the human fix succeed and at least one F2P test exists. During model evaluation, the inspected harness sets resolved=true only when every declared F2P and P2P test passes after the candidate patch. This contract observes patch application and declared test behavior, but it cannot prove semantic issue resolution outside the tests, detect all flaky or misparsed tests, or certify that a 95%-passing setup is fully correct.

The closest baseline is SWE-bench, which also evaluates repository patches with human tests but relies on a small manually configured repository set. The change is automated historical environment construction and expansion to applications and hundreds of repositories, not a new code-agent policy or a released trajectory schema. The direction signal is that an agent benchmark's environment generator, dependency cutoff, parser, test partitions, and terminal predicate are first-class evaluation data rather than incidental infrastructure.

SetUpAgent 把仓库文档和执行反馈转换为受历史时间约束的安装与测试命令，使解决 issue 的 pull request 无需逐仓库人工配置即可形成可执行的 SWA-Bench 和 SWEE-Bench 实例。

其机制分为作者定义的三个阶段。命令提取阶段读取仓库文本、CI/CD 文件及其引用网页；依赖解析使用 uv，并排除 issue 日期之后发布的版本。迭代测试阶段在干净的 Docker container 中运行候选命令，由 LLM 分类安装、测试或 Python 错误，再修订命令，最多进行四轮。验证阶段先用 LLM 判断安装与测试是否成功，再请求逐测试输出、选择 parser，并在至少 95% 的已解析测试通过时接受该环境（论文 §3.3 与 Figures 1–4，pp. 2–4；Appendix B，pp. 13–20）。

反馈契约有两个不同层次。构造时，LLM 判断、进程退出行为、测试解析和 95% 阈值共同决定环境是否可用；只有人工修复前后两次参考执行都成功且至少存在一个 F2P 测试，实例才会保留。模型评测时，检查过的 harness 只有在候选补丁使全部 F2P 与 P2P 测试通过时才设置 resolved=true。该契约能观察补丁应用和已声明测试行为，却不能证明测试范围之外的语义修复，不能发现所有 flaky 或误解析测试，也不能证明通过 95% 测试的环境完全正确。

最接近的基线是 SWE-bench：它同样以人工测试评估仓库补丁，但依赖少量人工配置的仓库。本文改变的是历史环境自动构造，以及向应用和数百个仓库扩展；它没有提出新的 code-agent policy，也没有发布 trajectory schema。其方向意义在于把 agent benchmark 的环境生成器、依赖时间截断、parser、测试分区和 terminal predicate 视为一等评测数据，而非附带基础设施。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs begin with real Python repositories and merged pull requests that resolve an issue and modify a test file. SWA combines 468 popular Python applications with 50 DyPyBench projects and deduplicates them to 475 candidate repositories; SWEE starts from the 8,000 most-downloaded PyPI projects under the paper's download/star criteria. Repositories are restricted to permissive licenses. The task formalization is (R,T,I,E,S,X): repository, original tests, issue, execution environment, reference test patch, and reference code patch (Paper §§3.1 and 4.1, pp. 3, 5–6).

SetUpAgent first extracts candidate install and test commands from repository text, CI/CD configuration, and linked pages. It uses uv to exclude dependency versions newer than the issue date and stores successful commands in a reference database for nearby repository versions. The default agent model is GPT-4o-mini, reported as gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, with greedy decoding. It then executes commands in separate Ubuntu 22.04-based Docker containers, classifies failures, and revises the commands for up to four iterations. The image digest, complete package manifest, exact uv version, index snapshot, seed, retry policy, and total token/cost budget are not disclosed (Paper §3.3, pp. 3–4; §5.1, p. 7; Appendix A Table 9, p. 12).

Validation combines an LLM setup-success judgment with test-level parsing and accepts when at least 95% of tests pass. For benchmark construction, the authors process eligible PRs, split code and test patches, run every test in T ∪ S on the pre-fix repository and on R ∘ X, and label each test P2P, F2P, F2F, or P2F. Cases with failed pre/post execution or no F2P test are rejected. SWA keeps up to 50 valid PRs per repository; SWEE keeps up to 10 after scraping up to 500 PRs (Paper §§3.1, 4.1; Tables 1 and 10).

The released output is one test split per Hub dataset. Rows store repository/commit provenance, issue and hint text, reference code/test patches, timestamps, four test-behavior lists, install commands, test framework/commands, and Docker image root. version and environment_setup_commit are typed but null in the current releases. Complete construction logs, failed attempts, per-row canonical issue/PR URLs, and immutable image digests are absent.

Evaluation submits a candidate repository patch to the SWE-bench-compatible fork. The inspected support branch applies the patch, runs row-specific commands, normalizes and parses logs, and marks the task resolved only when all F2P and P2P tests pass; timeout, missing markers, parser failure, or patch-application failure is unsuccessful. The paper evaluates OpenHands, AutoCodeRover v2, SWE-Agent v1, and ZeroShot variants. No training on SWA-Bench or SWEE-Bench is reported, so the supported use is evaluation only (Paper §§5.1–5.3, pp. 7–8; harness commit c11e96679247719201db83c06012adb3221b33be).

Reproduction must pin the PMLR paper version, Hub revisions, non-default harness support branch, parser behavior, Docker images, dependency-index state, and evaluation subset. The public harness fork is not the SetUpAgent generation implementation; no SetUpAgent source or reference-command database was found in the inspected official artifacts.

输入来自真实 Python 仓库，以及同时解决 issue 并修改测试文件的 merged pull request。SWA 汇合 468 个热门 Python 应用与 50 个 DyPyBench 项目，去重后得到 475 个候选仓库；SWEE 从论文下载量/星标条件下最常下载的 8,000 个 PyPI 项目开始。仓库被限制为 permissive license。任务形式化为 (R,T,I,E,S,X)：仓库、原始测试、issue、执行环境、参考测试补丁和参考代码补丁（论文 §§3.1、4.1，pp. 3、5–6）。

SetUpAgent 先从仓库文本、CI/CD 配置与引用网页提取候选安装和测试命令。它使用 uv 排除晚于 issue 日期发布的依赖版本，并把成功命令存入 reference database，以供相邻仓库版本复用。默认 agent 模型为 GPT-4o-mini，论文给出的准确 ID 是 gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18，使用 greedy decoding。随后，命令在独立的 Ubuntu 22.04-based Docker container 中执行；系统分类失败并最多修订四轮。image digest、完整 package manifest、准确 uv 版本、index snapshot、seed、retry policy 以及总 token/成本预算均未披露（论文 §3.3，pp. 3–4；§5.1，p. 7；Appendix A Table 9，p. 12）。

验证把 LLM 的 setup-success 判断与逐测试解析结合起来，在至少 95% 的测试通过时接受环境。构造基准时，作者处理合格 PR，拆分代码与测试补丁，在修复前仓库和 R ∘ X 上运行 T ∪ S 中的全部测试，并把每个测试标记为 P2P、F2P、F2F 或 P2F。修复前后任一执行失败或没有 F2P 测试的 case 都被拒绝。SWA 每仓库最多保留 50 个有效 PR；SWEE 在最多抓取 500 个 PR 后每仓库最多保留 10 个（论文 §§3.1、4.1；Tables 1、10）。

两个 Hub 数据集当前都只发布一个 test split。每行保存仓库/commit provenance、issue 与 hint 文本、参考代码/测试补丁、时间戳、四类测试行为列表、安装命令、测试 framework/commands 和 Docker image root。当前版本虽然声明了 version 与 environment_setup_commit 字段，但值为 null。完整构造日志、失败尝试、逐行 canonical issue/PR URL 与不可变 image digest 均未发布。

评测把候选仓库补丁提交给 SWE-bench-compatible fork。检查过的支持分支会应用补丁、运行逐行命令、标准化并解析日志；只有全部 F2P 与 P2P 测试通过，任务才判为 resolved。timeout、缺失 marker、parser failure 或 patch-application failure 都表示失败。论文评估了 OpenHands、AutoCodeRover v2、SWE-Agent v1 和 ZeroShot variants；没有报告在 SWA-Bench 或 SWEE-Bench 上训练，因此支持的用途仅为 evaluation（论文 §§5.1–5.3，pp. 7–8；harness commit c11e96679247719201db83c06012adb3221b33be）。

复现时必须固定 PMLR 论文版本、Hub revisions、非默认 harness 支持分支、parser 行为、Docker images、依赖 index 状态和评测子集。公开 harness fork 不是 SetUpAgent 的生成实现；在已检查的官方 artifacts 中没有找到 SetUpAgent 源码或 reference-command database。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The final ICML paper reports 535 SWA-Bench instances from 44 repositories and 885 SWEE-Bench instances from 366 repositories (Paper Table 1, §4.2, Appendix C Table 10 and repository lists). The current official Hub revisions do not reproduce those snapshots: SWA-Bench revision 9ce2651cf73f5cf691101ef5859ce3fccfc6cc24 exposes 450 test rows, while SWEE-Bench revision 012045a7367884b1e694c5840c409a9147daf58e exposes 798. The missing 85 and 87 rows are not explained by a public changelog, so paper-scale and current-release claims must remain separate.

A manual audit of 30 SWA instances found that all ran the intended tests, 23 used exactly the reference commands, and only 22 had fully correct setup. This is direct evidence that the 95% test threshold admits imperfect environments. The paper reports SetUpAgent success on 28.6% of SWA repositories and 58.5% of SWA instances, versus 21.6% and 71.5% for SWEE. On successful SWA repositories, the full method reaches 44, compared with 33 using CI/CD only, 15 using text only, and 11 without iterative improvement (Paper §4.3, p. 7; Tables 3–4, p. 8).

The evaluation results are version-sensitive. ArXiv v1 states up to 40% lower success and reports GPT-4o AutoCodeRover v2 at 10.2% on SWA versus 16.6% on SWE, a 6.4-point or 38.6%-relative decrease (arXiv v1 Table 6). The ICML/PMLR final abstract changes the headline to up to 60% after final Table 6 adds DeepSeek V3 at 8% on SWA versus 26% on SWE over 100 sampled instances. The 60% statement is the final-paper headline; the 40% statement belongs only to v1, and neither should be generalized beyond the stated agents, subsets, and harness.

For contamination, all evaluated models perform lower on post-knowledge-cutoff SWA tasks, but only GPT-4o reaches statistical significance; SWEE shows no comparable signal (Paper §5.4 and Table 8, pp. 8–9). This is suggestive stratification, not proof of training-corpus decontamination. Three SetUpAgent runs over 100 SWEE candidate repositories succeed on 27, 27, and 26 repositories, respectively (Appendix A.1, Table 11), which supports reported repeatability but is not an independent reproduction.

These experiments show that automated setup can expand the evaluation surface and that agent rankings/success vary with repository distribution. They do not certify every released environment, prove data quality from benchmark performance, establish dataset licensing, or reconcile the current Hub rows with the paper snapshot.

ICML 最终论文报告 SWA-Bench 含 44 个仓库的 535 个实例，SWEE-Bench 含 366 个仓库的 885 个实例（论文 Table 1、§4.2、Appendix C Table 10 及仓库列表）。当前官方 Hub revisions 并不复现这些快照：SWA-Bench revision 9ce2651cf73f5cf691101ef5859ce3fccfc6cc24 公开 450 行 test 数据，SWEE-Bench revision 012045a7367884b1e694c5840c409a9147daf58e 公开 798 行。缺少的 85 行和 87 行没有公开 changelog 解释，因此论文规模与当前发布规模必须分开表述。

对 30 个 SWA 实例的人工审计发现：全部实例运行了目标测试，23 个完全采用参考命令，但只有 22 个环境配置完全正确。这直接说明 95% 测试阈值会接受不完美环境。论文报告 SetUpAgent 在 SWA 上的仓库与实例成功率分别为 28.6% 和 58.5%，在 SWEE 上分别为 21.6% 和 71.5%。对成功的 SWA 仓库，完整方法得到 44 个，而仅使用 CI/CD、仅使用文本、去掉迭代改进时分别为 33、15、11 个（论文 §4.3，p. 7；Tables 3–4，p. 8）。

评测结果具有版本敏感性。ArXiv v1 声称成功率最多下降 40%，并在 Table 6 报告 GPT-4o AutoCodeRover v2 在 SWA 上为 10.2%、在 SWE 上为 16.6%，即下降 6.4 个百分点或相对下降 38.6%。ICML/PMLR 最终版摘要把 headline 改为最多下降 60%；最终 Table 6 新增了 100 个采样实例上的 DeepSeek V3 结果：SWA 为 8%，SWE 为 26%。60% 是最终论文表述，40% 只属于 v1；两者都不能超出相应 agent、subset 和 harness 条件泛化。

关于 contamination，所有被评模型在知识截止时间之后的 SWA 任务上表现更低，但只有 GPT-4o 达到统计显著；SWEE 没有类似信号（论文 §5.4 与 Table 8，pp. 8–9）。这只是提示性分层，不是训练语料去污染证明。SetUpAgent 在 100 个 SWEE 候选仓库上重复三次，分别成功 27、27、26 个（Appendix A.1，Table 11）；它支持作者报告的重复性，但不是独立复现。

这些实验说明自动配置可以扩大评测面，而且 agent 排名或成功率会随仓库分布变化。它们不能认证每个发布环境，不能以 benchmark 性能证明数据质量，不能确立数据集 license，也不能解释当前 Hub 行与论文快照的差异。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
SWE-bench established the repository-level issue-resolution task and test-based patch evaluation, but its historically accurate environments required substantial manual effort and covered 12 selected repositories. Earlier automated benchmark generation could source issues or patches without fully solving historical dependency setup, test-command discovery, and heterogeneous result parsing at the same scale.

The specific change is to make environment reconstruction an automated, feedback-bearing pipeline: extract commands from multiple repository evidence sources, enforce issue-time dependency cutoffs with uv, repair commands from clean-container failures, validate with an LLM plus test parsing, reuse successful commands across nearby versions, and then derive F2P/P2P/P2F/F2F partitions from reference executions. This enables an application-focused benchmark and a broader repository benchmark without claiming a new agent-learning algorithm.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is the richer evaluation object. The issue text and reference patch are insufficient by themselves; the dependency date, setup commands, parser, Docker state, test partitions, and terminal predicate jointly determine the label. SWA-Bench also tests a distribution that differs from library-centric SWE-bench, while SWEE-Bench broadens the repository pool. These are evaluation-surface changes, not evidence that the released data is suitable for training.

What is not new includes GitHub issue/PR mining, Docker execution, LLM-based command suggestion, unit-test evaluation, SWE-bench's patch task, and F2P/P2P-style outcome checks. Much of the contribution is systems integration and scale. Before reuse, inspect the non-default harness branch, test-parser behavior, paper-to-Hub count drift, missing SetUpAgent generator code, mutable Docker tags, one-split release, dataset license, and lack of rejected setup records.

SWE-bench 已经建立了仓库级 issue resolution 任务与基于测试的补丁评测，但其历史准确环境需要大量人工工作，并只覆盖 12 个选定仓库。已有自动基准构造可以获取 issue 或补丁，却没有在同等规模上同时解决历史依赖配置、测试命令发现和异构结果解析。

本文的具体变化是把环境重建变为自动、带反馈的 pipeline：从多种仓库证据中提取命令，用 uv 强制执行 issue-time 依赖截断，根据干净 container 中的失败修复命令，以 LLM 加测试解析进行验证，在相邻版本间复用成功命令，再从参考执行得到 F2P/P2P/P2F/F2F 分区。由此可以构造一个面向应用的基准和一个仓库覆盖更广的基准，但没有声称提出新的 agent-learning algorithm。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号来自更丰富的评测对象。issue 文本与参考补丁本身并不充分；依赖日期、setup commands、parser、Docker 状态、测试分区和 terminal predicate 共同决定标签。SWA-Bench 还考察了不同于 library-centric SWE-bench 的分布，SWEE-Bench 则扩大仓库池。这些是 evaluation surface 的改变，不是公开数据适合训练的证据。

并非新贡献的组件包括 GitHub issue/PR mining、Docker 执行、LLM 命令建议、unit-test evaluation、SWE-bench 补丁任务和 F2P/P2P 式结果判定。贡献中相当部分属于系统整合与规模扩展。复用前应检查非默认 harness branch、测试 parser 行为、论文与 Hub 行数漂移、缺失的 SetUpAgent generator code、可变 Docker tags、单 split 发布、数据集 license，以及没有发布被拒 setup 记录的问题。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• SetUpAgent generation code, the reference-command database, full prompts-as-code, system messages, seeds, API retries, and token/cost budgets were not found in the inspected official artifacts. The public SWEBench fork contains evaluator adaptations, not the benchmark-generation implementation.
  • Historical reproducibility is incomplete: the exact uv version, package-index snapshot, Ubuntu base-image digest, full package manifest, and per-task immutable Docker digests are unknown. Mutable tags can change replay behavior.
  • A 95% test-pass threshold is not equivalent to a fully correct setup. The SWA manual audit found 22 fully correct setups among 30 sampled instances, leaving false-positive setup acceptance as a demonstrated risk.
  • The terminal predicate is test-relative. Incomplete, flaky, over-specific, leaked, or misparsed tests can produce false positives or false negatives; parser handling of XFAIL/XPASS and missing names is a concrete sensitivity in the inspected branch.
  • Current official releases expose 450 SWA and 798 SWEE rows rather than the paper's 535 and 885, without an instance-removal manifest or changelog. Scores and samples can drift depending on the revision used.
  • Both Hub releases contain only a public test split. The paper reports no complete instance-level overlap audit against other SWE benchmarks and no direct model-training-corpus decontamination check.
  • The source repositories were filtered for permissive licenses, but neither dataset release declares a dataset license. Rights and attribution for issue text, PR text, patches, tests, dependencies, and contributor content remain unresolved.
  • Failed setups, rejected PRs, parser failures, no-F2P cases, and complete execution logs are not released. This prevents analysis of failure distributions and may hide systematic environment-selection bias.
  • The paper's agent evaluation is cost-limited: SWEE and SWE-Full are uniformly subsampled to 535 instances for the main comparison, while some final-version rows use 100-instance subsets. Reported relative gaps should not be interpreted as full-dataset constants.
  • Privacy, contributor consent, and governance treatment for public GitHub text and code are unknown. Public availability does not by itself establish permission for benchmark redistribution or downstream training.

• 在已检查的官方 artifacts 中没有找到 SetUpAgent 生成源码、reference-command database、完整 prompts-as-code、system messages、seeds、API retries 和 token/成本预算。公开 SWEBench fork 提供 evaluator 适配，不是 benchmark generation 实现。
  • 历史复现信息不完整：准确 uv 版本、package-index snapshot、Ubuntu base-image digest、完整 package manifest 和逐任务不可变 Docker digest 均为 unknown；可变 tag 会改变重放行为。
  • 95% 测试通过阈值不等于环境完全正确。SWA 人工审计的 30 个样本中只有 22 个 setup 完全正确，说明 false-positive setup acceptance 是已经观察到的风险。
  • Terminal predicate 依赖测试。测试不完整、flaky、过度具体、泄漏或误解析都可能造成 false positive 或 false negative；检查过的分支对 XFAIL/XPASS 和缺失测试名的处理是一个具体敏感点。
  • 当前官方发布含 450 个 SWA 与 798 个 SWEE 行，不是论文中的 535 与 885，且没有 instance-removal manifest 或 changelog。评测分数和抽样会随 revision 漂移。
  • 两个 Hub 发布都只有公开 test split。论文没有报告与其他 SWE benchmarks 的完整逐实例 overlap audit，也没有直接进行 model-training-corpus decontamination 检查。
  • 源仓库经过 permissive license 筛选，但两个数据集发布都没有声明 dataset license。issue 文本、PR 文本、补丁、测试、依赖和贡献者内容的权利与 attribution 仍未解决。
  • 失败 setup、被拒 PR、parser failure、无 F2P case 和完整执行日志均未发布。这阻碍对失败分布的分析，也可能隐藏系统性环境选择偏差。
  • 论文的 agent 评测受成本限制：主比较把 SWEE 与 SWE-Full 均匀下采样到 535 个实例，而最终版部分结果使用 100-instance subset。报告的相对差距不应被解释为完整数据集常数。
  • 对公开 GitHub 文本与代码的 privacy、contributor consent 和 governance 处理为 unknown。公开可见本身不等于允许基准再分发或下游训练。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, use this paper as an evaluation-environment case study rather than as trajectory training data. A repository-agent benchmark record should preserve the pinned checkout, issue prompt, reference code and test patches, historical install/test commands, test-behavior partitions, parser version, container identity, submitted model patch, and terminal result. SWA-Bench and SWEE-Bench expose much of the task side of this schema, but not the evaluated agent's action/observation trajectory.

For code-agent evaluation, the benchmarks can test whether conclusions derived from a small set of popular libraries transfer to applications and a broader PyPI-oriented repository pool. A controlled study should pin one Hub revision, one non-default harness branch/commit, one container manifest, one parser implementation, and one agent scaffold; report the exact instance subset and failures before comparing resolved rates.

For benchmark-construction research, SetUpAgent supplies a concrete three-stage recipe: extract commands from repository evidence, repair them through clean-environment execution feedback, then validate with test parsing and a 95% threshold. Useful ablations include removing CI/CD context, removing iterative repair, varying the 95% threshold, changing the uv time cutoff, or auditing parser decisions against manual labels. These are evaluation and audit experiments; the paper provides no basis for SFT, RLVR, or agent-training use.

For release audit, compare the paper's 535/885 instances with the current 450/798 Hub rows, trace removed instances, test whether Docker tags still reproduce pinned rows, and quantify F2P/P2P parser false positives and false negatives. The 40% arXiv v1 headline and 60% final-paper headline should be treated as versioned claims, not merged into one unqualified result.

Reuse classification is evaluation only, with material restrictions. The paper and public task artifacts are suitable for studying repository-level evaluation design, distribution shift, historical setup, and terminal predicates. Training reuse is unsupported by the paper and additionally blocked by an unknown dataset license, missing generator code, incomplete environment pinning, and unresolved release drift.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 而言，本论文应被用作评测环境案例，而不是 trajectory training data。一个仓库 agent benchmark 记录应保留固定 checkout、issue prompt、参考代码与测试补丁、历史安装/测试命令、测试行为分区、parser 版本、container identity、模型提交补丁和终态结果。SWA-Bench 与 SWEE-Bench 公开了该 schema 的大部分任务侧字段，但没有公开被评 agent 的 action/observation trajectory。

在 code-agent evaluation 中，这两个基准可用于检验从少量热门 library 得出的结论能否迁移到应用，以及覆盖更广的 PyPI-oriented 仓库池。受控实验应固定一个 Hub revision、一个非默认 harness branch/commit、一份 container manifest、一个 parser 实现和一个 agent scaffold，并在比较 resolved rate 前报告准确 instance subset 与失败记录。

在 benchmark construction 研究中，SetUpAgent 提供具体三阶段配方：从仓库证据提取命令，通过干净环境的执行反馈修复命令，再用测试解析与 95% 阈值验证。可执行的消融包括去掉 CI/CD context、去掉 iterative repair、改变 95% 阈值、改变 uv 时间截断，或用人工标签审计 parser 决策。这些属于 evaluation 与 audit 实验；论文没有为 SFT、RLVR 或 agent training 提供依据。

在发布审计中，应把论文的 535/885 个实例与当前 Hub 的 450/798 行对照，追踪被移除的实例，检查 Docker tags 是否仍能重放固定行，并量化 F2P/P2P parser 的 false positive 与 false negative。ArXiv v1 的 40% headline 与最终论文的 60% headline 必须作为版本化主张处理，不能合并为一个无条件结果。

复用分类为 evaluation only，并有实质限制。论文和公开任务 artifacts 适合研究仓库级评测设计、分布转移、历史环境配置和 terminal predicate。论文不支持训练复用；unknown dataset license、缺失 generator code、不完整环境固定和未解决的 release drift 也进一步阻止训练用途。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Remember the released object: repository task rows plus setup/test metadata and Docker targets; no agent action/observation trajectory or reasoning trace is released.
  • Read §3.3 and Figures 1–4 for SetUpAgent's extraction, iterative repair, and validation phases; Appendix B contains the prompt templates.
  • Keep the two thresholds distinct: at least 95% parsed tests for accepting a setup, then all F2P and P2P tests for a model patch to be resolved.
  • Do not merge versions: arXiv v1 reports up to 40% lower success, while the ICML/PMLR final paper reports up to 60% after adding 100-instance rows.
  • Audit release drift before scoring: the paper reports SWA 535/44 and SWEE 885/366, whereas current Hub revisions expose 450 and 798 rows.
  • The public fork supports evaluation on non-default branches; SetUpAgent generation code, dataset licenses, immutable image manifests, and rejected setup records remain unavailable or unknown.

• 首先记住发布对象：仓库任务行、setup/test 元数据和 Docker targets；没有发布 agent action/observation trajectory 或 reasoning trace。
  • 阅读 §3.3 与 Figures 1–4 了解 SetUpAgent 的提取、迭代修复和验证三阶段；Appendix B 给出 prompt templates。
  • 区分两个阈值：接受 setup 需要至少 95% 的已解析测试通过，而模型补丁被判 resolved 则需要全部 F2P 与 P2P 测试通过。
  • 不要合并版本：arXiv v1 报告成功率最多下降 40%，ICML/PMLR 最终版在加入 100-instance 结果后报告最多下降 60%。
  • 打分前审计 release drift：论文报告 SWA 535/44、SWEE 885/366，而当前 Hub revisions 公开 450 和 798 行。
  • 公开 fork 只在非默认分支支持评测；SetUpAgent 生成源码、dataset licenses、不可变 image manifests 和被拒 setup 记录仍不可用或为 unknown。
